FX-GRID-001.says: The settings as they start: anchor in the middle, Corner Point at (60, 60) per cent, cells 1.6 by 1 pixels in this small drawing, border 2, white, blending mode none: the lines are thicker than the cells, so the whole layer is the grid's white and the cel is gone.

FX-GRID-002.says: Width Slider 4, border 1, the anchor at (8, 5): the lines run along pixel edges, so they are two half-covered pixels wide, and three quarters where they cross.

FX-GRID-003.says: Width Slider 4, border 1, the anchor at (8.5, 5.5): the lines run through pixel centres, so columns 0, 4, 8, 12 and rows 1, 5, 9 are white, the rest clear.

FX-GRID-004.says: Width & Height Sliders 4 by 2, border 1, the anchor at (8, 5).

FX-GRID-005.says: Corner Point with the corner at (75, 70) per cent, (12, 7) pixels: cells 4 by 2, FX-GRID-004's.

FX-GRID-006.says: Border 0: no grid at all, the layer clear.

FX-GRID-007.says: Width 4, border 2, feather width 2: the upright lines ramp over 2 pixels each side, the level ones stay sharp.

FX-GRID-008.says: Width 5, border 3, both feathers 4: soft lines both ways.

FX-GRID-009.says: FX-GRID-003 with Invert Grid: the cells white, the lines clear.

FX-GRID-011.says: FX-GRID-003, normal: white lines over the cel.

FX-GRID-012.says: FX-GRID-003 in violet #6450a0, multiply: the cel darkened and tinted on the lines, as it was elsewhere.

FX-GRID-017.says: FX-GRID-003, stencil alpha: the grid as a mask, the cel kept only on the lines.

FX-GRID-018.says: FX-GRID-003, normal at opacity 0: the cel exactly as it was.

FX-GRID-019.says: Width 4, border 1, the anchor keyed from (53.125, 55) at frame 0 to (78.125, 55) at frame 4, linear: the lines slide right 1 pixel a frame; frame 4, moved one cell, is frame 0.

FX-GRID-020.says: Width 4, the border keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 4 at frame 4, linear: frame 2 is border 2.

FX-GRID-021.says: FX-GRID-011 moved three pixels right: the grid moves with the layer.

FX-GRID-022.says: After a Motion Tile that grows the layer: the anchor is the drawing's own, so the frame is FX-GRID-003's.

FX-GRID-023.says: FX-GRID-010 with its colour in capitals, #FF8000: the same.

FX-GRID-024.says: Width 2, border 3: the lines wider than the cells, every pixel white.

FX-GRID-025.says: Opacity keyed from 100 at frame 0 to 0 at frame 4 past its end by an ease, FX-GRID-003, none: held at 0, frame 4 is clear everywhere.

FX-GRID-026.says: Invert Grid with stencil alpha: the cel kept only in the cells.

FX-GRID-027.says: Width 3, border 0.5, the anchor at (-100, -100) per cent, outside the drawing: thin lines still across the whole layer, each pixel covered by the share of it a line crosses.

FX-GRID-028.says: Width 0, below 1. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-GRID-029.says: Height 10001, above 10000. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-GRID-030.says: Border -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-GRID-031.says: Feather height 10001, above 10000. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-GRID-032.says: Opacity 101, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-GRID-033.says: Anchor 1001 per cent across, above 1000. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-GRID-034.says: Size From "corner", not one of its three words. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-GRID-035.says: Blending mode "darken", which this program does not have. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-GRID-036.says: Colour "#12345", not six hex digits. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-GRID-037.says: Invert "yes", not off or on. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-GRID-038.says: Border keyed to 10001 at frame 4, above 10000. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
